title: Source Proof Hardening: trusted rows must be licensed and linked

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.89 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a source-proof hardening release; targeted source/export regressions plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on local regressions and prior v0.15.86/v0.15.87 ZIP/log evidence. A fresh deployed v0.15.89 ZIP/log audit is still required before claiming provider package quality improvement.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: Trusted sourceLedger rows now require accessible reference proof, non-ambiguous license proof, trust-eligible provider status, and concept links; weaker rows are preserved as sourceReviewRows.
Section-attached resources now inherit the section topic as a concept label when explicit concept ids are unavailable, keeping valid source text linked instead of unlinked.
Source-ledger bundle merging now collects trusted rows before review rows and suppresses weaker review duplicates when the same DOI or URL already has trusted proof.
The release explicitly carries forward fresh deployed ZIP/log validation before claiming a 100/100 package or provider-side score improvement.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh ZIP/log audit and compare citation score, sourceReviewRows, SOURCE_REPORT.md, and local deep quality regrade against the v0.15.86/v0.15.87 evidence.
Continue source, texture, local-save, and export-quality audits from fresh provider evidence.
